scheduled_maintenances.name: Zoom Phone India Maintenance (Hyderabad Data Center): October 09, 2026

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

Zoom Phone users registered to the India (Hyderabad) Data Center will be automatically registered in an alternative Data Center (Mumbai) starting at 09th October 2026 04:30 AM PDT (5:00 PM IST on 09th October 2026). During the maintenance window, a brief disconnection may be experienced and notifications may be missed. If you get disconnected, the system will attempt to reconnect you automatically. 

If you are a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) customer, please ensure that your Session Border Controller (SBC) is configured with alternate routing to alternate India (Mumbai) Data Center in addition to the India (Hyderabad) Data Center. During the maintenance window, connectivity to Zoom’s Hyderabad Data Center will be blocked which will force calls from the Session Border Controller (SBC) to failover to Zoom’s India (Mumbai) Data Center. Traffic will continue to be routed through the Zoom's India (Hyderabad) Data Center once the maintenance is completed. 

For customers that use hardware phones, refer to this link for the devices support the alternative datacenter process as described above: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0061373#h_01GNZ783VT6YXHES8NSXBA5M9A

scheduled_maintenances.name: Announcing Updated IP Address Ranges: September 28, 2026 (No Operational Impact)

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

The published IP range for Zoom Meeting and Zoom Phone services has been updated from 192.204.12.0/22 to 192.204.12.0/23. We recommend that network administrators, with Zoom-specific firewall or network rules, update their systems as soon as possible in preparation.

Mask change for Zoom Phone and Zoom Meetings service:
192.204.12.0/22 changed to 192.204.12.0/23

In addition, Zoom has updated the published IP range files to remove redundant entries that were fully contained within larger, overlapping subnet blocks for the Zoom Phone and ZoomCDN. This does not introduce any new IP ranges or remove any active ranges from service. The following adjustments have been made:

ZoomPhone.txt:
Two redundant entries, 173.231.92.0/24 and 173.231.94.0/24, were removed, as both are fully contained within the existing 173.231.80.0/20 range already listed in the same file.

ZoomCDN-IPv6.txt: 
Two adjacent entries, 2407:30c0:180::/48 and 2407:30c0:181::/48, were consolidated into a single 2407:30c0:180::/47.

While the ranges have been consolidated for the ZoomPhone.txt file, additional files have been generated for the individual Zoom Phone rules, specifically:
ZoomPhone-TCP443.txt
ZoomPhone-TCP5091.txt
ZoomPhone-TCP390.txt
ZoomPhone-UDP3478.txt
ZoomPhone-UDP20000-64000.txt

These updates have no operational impact. Network administrators do not need to take any action unless they maintain custom scripts or automation that reference the previous redundant entries

We have also updated the Zoom CRC JSON file to reflect the current domains utilized for joining Zoom Meetings.

For a complete list, please see: 

https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/Zoom.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomMeetings.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomPhone.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomPhone-TCP443.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomPhone-TCP5091.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomPhone-TCP390.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomPhone-UDP3478.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomPhone-UDP20000-64000.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomCDN-IPv6.txt
https://assets.zoom.us/docs/ipranges/ZoomCRCDomains.json

A complete list of network firewall IP ranges and domains for Zoom can be found on the Zoom Support site at:
https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0060548

scheduled_maintenances.name: Zoom Phone India Maintenance (Mumbai) : September 25, 2026

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
Maintenance will begin as scheduled in 60 minutes.

Zoom Phone users registered to the India (Mumbai) Data Center will be automatically registered in an alternative datacenter (Hyderabad) starting at 25th September 2026 04:30 AM PDT (5:00 PM IST on 25th September 2026). During the maintenance window, a brief disconnection may be experienced and notifications may be missed. If you get disconnected, the system will attempt to reconnect you automatically. 

If you are a BYOC (Bring Your Own Carrier) customer, please ensure that your Session Border Controller (SBC) is configured with alternate routing to alternate India (Hyderabad) Data Center in addition to the India (Mumbai) Data Center. During the maintenance window, connectivity to Zoom’s Mumbai Data Center will be blocked which will force calls from the Session Border Controller (SBC) to failover to Zoom’s India (Hyderabad) Data Center. Traffic will continue to be routed through the Zoom's India (Mumbai) Data Center once the maintenance is completed. 

For customers that use hardware phones, refer to this link for the devices support the alternative datacenter process as described above: https://support.zoom.com/hc/en/article?id=zm_kb&sysparm_article=KB0061373#h_01GNZ783VT6YXHES8NSXBA5M9A
